senses.gloss:
अञ्च् अञ्च् (cf. अङ्क), i. 1, Par. Ātm.
 1. To go.
 2. To ask.
 3. To speak indistiṅctly.
 4. To bend, to curve, Nal. 12, 45.
 5. To honour, Ragh. 9, 24.
 6. i. 10 (rather Caus.). To make clear, to manifest, Gīt. 10, 11.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, To rise, Rājat. 5, 362.
अञ्चन अञ्च् + अन, n. Bending, curving.
अञ्चल अञ्च् + अल, m. The end or border of a cloth.
